title: Unconstrained Delegation

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1558 Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets

description: A host configured for unconstrained delegation caches the Kerberos Ticket-Granting Tickets (TGTs) of any user that authenticates to it. An attacker who compromises such a host can extract cached TGTs, including those of privileged users and Domain Controllers, and impersonate them anywhere in the domain. Coercing a Domain Controller to authenticate to the host can lead to full domain compromise.
businessImpact: Critical --- extraction of a Domain Controller or Domain Admin TGT enables impersonation of any principal and typically results in complete compromise of the Active Directory environment.
remediation:
- Remove unconstrained delegation from all accounts and computers; use constrained or resource-based constrained delegation instead.
- Add sensitive and privileged accounts to the Protected Users group and mark them as "Account is sensitive and cannot be delegated".
- Restrict and monitor which hosts are trusted for delegation.
- Patch and monitor for authentication coercion techniques used to trigger DC authentication.
